name: dispatch_to_subroutine

name: draw_rows_after_vblank

name: run_two_subroutines

name: sweep_position_up_and_down

name: set_mode_word_around_call

name: set_mode_word_around_call

name: call_vector_thirteen_times

name: update_channel_levels_per_frame
description: When a flag word is clear, it clamps two input words to a fixed ceiling, scales each to a level from 0 to 14, and calls a routine to apply the change on two channels whenever a level differs from the stored one.

name: apply_shifted_value_when_enabled

name: apply_delta_to_stored_value
description: When a flag is clear and a value is non-negative, it replaces the stored shifted value with the new one and passes the difference between a constant and the previous stored value to a routine.

name: call_routine_if_positive
description: Calls a routine only when a 16-bit value is non-negative and its shifted upper part is non-zero.

name: call_twice_with_swapped_pointer

name: store_bounds_then_call_four

description: XORs two 16-bit words at fixed locations, shifts the result left by two, and stores it in a third word.

name: mask_background_block_planes
description: When a state flag is clear, ANDs a two-column by twelve-row block of four bitplanes with a matching mask and stores the result in a buffer.

name: read_pixel_color_index
description: Tests the bit for an x-coordinate in each of four bitplanes at a row offset and returns the combined four-bit colour index with the word position.

name: zero_hundred_buffer_rows
description: Zeroes one hundred rows of a memory buffer, writing 81 longwords per row while walking backwards from a base offset of 32000 bytes.

name: clear_rows_from_offset_table
description: Clears a range of rows in a bitplane, looking each row's start up in an offset table indexed by a stored value. The row count comes from the state block and each row is cleared with backward longword writes.

name: fill_rows_by_control_bits
description: Selects a fill value from bits of a control word, calls routines for the low control bits, then fills a count of rows with either all-zero or all-one longwords.

name: fill_rows_with_zeros
description: Writes zero into ten longwords per row for a row count stored in the state block, walking backwards through the buffer.

name: fill_rows_with_ones
description: Writes all-one longwords into ten longwords per row for a row count stored in the state block, walking backwards through the buffer.

name: compute_row_offset_and_count
description: Computes a byte offset for the current row from a row word using a stride of 40, and stores a row count derived from two row words.

name: copy_memory_block_chunked
description: Copies 32000 bytes from a source pointer to a destination pointer in eight-longword chunks.

name: call_blit_bitmap_vector
description: Calls the graphics library's bitmap blit routine through its jump vector and returns nothing of its own.

name: advance_pseudo_random_word
description: Multiplies a stored 16-bit state word by the fixed multiplier 31415, adds one, saves the result back, and returns the product's high part alongside the new value.

name: build_row_offset_table
description: Fills a table with word values that step by 40 per row, using a row count from the state block, and stores the table pointer and a companion pointer.

name: merge_source_planes_by_mask
description: Combines a source image with a destination across four bitplanes, byte by byte, using two mask bytes. Byte positions are visited in an order set by a 16-bit pattern over 64000 bytes.

name: dispatch_if_point_in_bounds
description: Checks that an x value lies from 0 to 319 and a y value lies between two bounds in the state block, then calls a routine chosen from a jump table by an index.

name: call_routine_from_table
description: Calls a routine selected from a jump table by an index held in a data register.

name: call_routine_per_span
description: Calls one routine once, then calls a function pointer once for each step of a count derived from the difference between two register values.

name: mask_bits_in_all_planes
description: ANDs a 16-bit mask with the word at one position in each of four bitplanes.

name: set_bits_in_plane_0
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in plane 0 and ANDs a mask into the same word in the other three planes.

name: set_bits_in_plane_1
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in plane 1 and ANDs a mask into the same word in the other three planes.

name: set_bits_planes_01
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 0 and 1 and ANDs a mask into the same word in planes 2 and 3.

name: set_bits_in_plane_2

name: set_bits_planes_02

name: set_bits_planes_12
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 1 and 2 and ANDs a mask into the same word in planes 0 and 3.

name: set_bits_planes_012

name: set_bits_in_plane_3

name: set_bits_planes_03

name: set_bits_planes_13
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 1 and 3 and ANDs a mask into the same word in planes 0 and 2.

name: set_bits_planes_013
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 0, 1 and 3 and ANDs a mask into the same word in plane 2.

name: set_bits_planes_23
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 2 and 3 and ANDs a mask into the same word in planes 0 and 1.

name: set_bits_planes_023
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 0, 2 and 3 and ANDs a mask into the same word in plane 1.

name: set_bits_planes_123
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 1, 2 and 3 and ANDs a mask into the same word in plane 0.

name: set_bits_in_all_planes
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in all four bitplanes.

name: fill_span_between_column_edges
description: Fills the bitplane words between a left and a right column, masking the two end words. It then walks edge pairs at a 40-byte row stride and sets or clears pixels across the four planes; this part is not reached in the reference run.

name: rasterize_polygon_edges
description: Walks vertex pairs and interpolates each edge's x-position with fixed-point division into a per-row table, tracking the top and bottom rows. It then fills the rows between them across the four bitplanes using a colour index from the state block.

name: clip_polygon_to_bounds
description: Clips a list of vertex coordinates against four bounds held in the state block, one bound at a time, writing the kept and crossing points to a shared buffer. Its callees are the per-bound crossing routines.

name: emit_crossing_for_bound_four
description: Writes the fourth bound value to the output, then when the segment crosses that bound it interpolates the crossing coordinate and stores it as well.

name: emit_crossing_for_bound_three
description: Writes the third bound value minus one to the output, then when the segment crosses that bound it interpolates the crossing coordinate and stores it as well.

name: emit_crossing_for_bound_one
description: Writes the first bound value to the output, then when the segment crosses that bound it interpolates the crossing coordinate into the second output array.

name: emit_crossing_for_bound_two
description: Writes the second bound value to the output, then when the segment crosses that bound it interpolates the crossing coordinate into the second output array.

name: dispatch_span_fill_routine
description: Sorts two x-positions, converts them to byte offsets within a bitplane row, and calls a fill routine chosen from a table by an index. When the two offsets are equal it calls that routine once.

name: call_indexed_routine_pointer
description: Calls a routine selected by an index held in a data register, through an indirect call that the decompiler could not resolve to a fixed target.

name: call_indexed_routine_pointer
description: Calls a routine selected by an index held in a data register, through an indirect call that the decompiler could not resolve to a fixed target.

name: clear_span_between_edge_masks
description: Applies a mask to the four bitplane words at the left end of a row, zeroes the words between the two ends in all four planes, and applies a second mask to the right end.

name: mask_bits_in_all_planes
description: ANDs a mask value with the word at one position in each of the four bitplanes.

name: set_bits_in_plane_0

name: set_bits_planes_01
description: ORs a value into the word at one position in planes 0 and 1 and ANDs a mask into the same word in planes 2 and 3.

name: draw_pixels_along_bit_walk
description: Walks the set bits of a 16-bit word, moving to a new byte column whenever a bit is found, and writes masked pixel values into four bitplanes at each step. It returns when the walk runs out of bits.

name: advance_phase_and_copy_table
description: Advances a cyclic phase counter between 1 and 11 in the state block, or takes a phase from a routine when a flag is set. It then copies four words from a lookup table selected by that phase into four destination slots.

name: refresh_and_set_display_fields
description: When a state flag is clear, calls a routine and then sets bits in six words of a display list while clearing bits in the other six.

name: set_and_clear_display_fields
description: Sets bits in six of twelve 16-bit display-list words and clears bits in the other six, using fixed masks at offsets from a base pointer passed in a register.

name: clear_display_fields_when_idle
description: When a state flag is clear and a second state word is zero, calls a routine and then clears a bit range in twelve display-list words.

name: clear_display_fields
description: Clears a bit range in twelve 16-bit display-list words using a fixed mask, at offsets from a base pointer passed in a register.

name: run_pending_update_steps
description: When a state flag is clear, calls a routine and resets a pending word to zero if it was set, then calls three more routines.

name: call_routine_when_enabled

name: fill_rectangle_rows_in_bounds
description: Checks that a rectangle lies inside the 320 by 200 screen, then steps down its rows at a 40-byte stride, calling a routine for each row.

name: draw_small_glyph_nibbles

name: copy_sixteen_words_to_buffer

name: copy_thirty_two_words
description: Copies thirty-two 16-bit words from a source table, whose address is read from global data, into a fixed buffer.

name: copy_palette_block_to_buffer
description: Copies a block of colour data from the source pointer into one of two buffers chosen by a flag, sixteen longwords for one buffer and eight for the other, then calls a routine.

name: load_rgb4_palette

name: load_rgb4_palette
description: Loads a colour table into the hardware colour registers through the graphics library's LoadRGB4 call, then calls another routine.

name: copy_eight_words_then_call
description: Copies eight words of colour data from the source pointer into a buffer selected by a global pointer, then calls a routine.

name: clear_colour_buffer
description: Zeroes either eight or sixteen longwords of a colour buffer, depending on a flag, then calls a routine.

name: write_colour_registers_direct
description: Copies sixteen words of colour data directly into the custom chip's colour register block.

name: restore_colour_block_from_buffer
description: Copies colour data back from one of two buffers into the source pointer, sixteen longwords or eight longwords according to a flag, then calls a routine.

name: step_down_colour_nibbles
description: Repeatedly decrements the low and high nibbles of each entry in a table of 32 or 64 bytes toward zero, calling a routine after each pass, until no entry changes.

name: repeat_pair_until_count_zero
description: Calls one routine, then repeatedly calls two others while a count register is non-zero.

name: run_pair_loop_after_setup

name: load_view_after_setup

name: call_then_load_view

name: step_colour_nibbles_toward_target

name: call_pair_then_clear_word
description: Calls two routines, then either calls a third routine when a count is non-zero or clears a state word to zero.

name: step_colour_words_down
description: Copies eight longwords from a table referenced by the state block into a work buffer, then decrements each of the three 4-bit channels in eight words by one step toward zero.

name: blend_colour_entry_and_store
description: Blends each 4-bit colour channel between two source colours using a factor divided by fifteen, repacks the three channels into one colour word, and stores it in two colour tables. It calls a routine when a state flag says so.

name: clear_rectangle_in_planes
description: Clears a rectangular block of words in all four bitplanes, with the block's position and size taken from the state block and a row offset table.

name: call_blit_bitmap_vector

name: call_blit_bitmap_vector

name: advance_counter_with_wrap
description: Calls a routine unless a counter is at its lowest value, then adds three to the counter and wraps it back to the lower bound once it passes 251.

name: copy_rectangle_between_planes
description: Copies a rectangular block of words across four bitplanes from a source position to a destination position, using row offset tables and a row stride on each side.

name: blit_when_row_before_limit

name: blit_when_positive

name: clip_rectangle_to_window

name: blit_computed_rectangle_twice

name: blit_computed_rectangle_twice
description: Calls a routine to compute a blit argument, then calls the graphics library's BltBitMap through its jump vector twice.

name: read_one_byte_from_file
description: Calls the DOS library's Read routine through its jump vector and returns the first byte of the buffer it filled.

name: silence_audio_channels
description: Calls four routines, writes zero to the four audio channel volume registers, then runs an empty loop on a timer word.

name: forward_to_subroutine
description: Calls one other routine and returns without a value of its own.

name: start_audio_channel_sample
description: When a sound flag is clear, waits for the top of the frame twice, then starts playback on one audio channel by writing its sample pointer, length, period and volume and enabling that channel's DMA and interrupt bits.

name: set_audio_channel_registers
description: When a sound flag is clear, writes the sample pointer, length, period and volume of one audio channel to its hardware registers and sets that channel's DMA and interrupt enable bits.

name: trigger_sound_on_channels
description: When a sound flag is clear, calls routines for each channel bit set in a mask, then stores a rate, a maximum level and a count for the sound and records the channel mask.

name: busy_wait_delay
description: Spins through about twenty-one thousand iterations of an empty loop as a pure delay.

name: select_channel_from_lowest_bit
description: When a sound flag is clear, finds the index of the lowest set bit in a channel mask, looks up a value for that index in a table, and stores it with a playback state code.

name: step_audio_envelope_tick
description: Advances an envelope level by a scaled step toward a target and ends the envelope when the target is reached. It writes the new level to the period and volume registers of each selected audio channel.

name: build_channel_bit_mask
description: Converts a channel number into a single-bit mask, which is used when enabling or disabling a channel's DMA.

name: reset_audio_driver_state
description: Calls four routines, then clears several audio driver state words, sets one default value and sets a driver flag to one.

name: skip_spaces_and_read_command
description: Skips space characters from an input source, then reads one command character. For the letter g it marks a flag while reading input up to a zero byte, then clears the flag and sets a result word.

name: wait_for_nonzero_input
description: Sets a driver flag, calls a routine repeatedly until it returns a non-zero value, then clears the flag and sets a result word to all ones.

name: service_audio_tick
description: Runs once per audio tick: it advances the sequence position, reads the next value for each channel, calls routines to start or update notes, and steps an envelope level. It is the periodic audio update.

name: clear_driver_busy_flag
description: Clears the driver's busy flag to zero and returns the stacked argument unchanged.

name: advance_sequence_track
description: Reads the next entry of a sequence, points a track pointer at the table offset that entry names, and sets the pending-state words; a zero entry ends the track.

name: set_step_direction_from_value
description: Reads a value from a routine and sets a step direction word to one when it is zero, or to minus one otherwise.

name: set_pointer_from_table_entry
description: Reads an index value and stores a pointer, computed from a four-byte table entry relative to the state block base, in a state-block field.

name: load_table_word_by_index
description: Reads an index value and stores the word at that index of a table into a shared word variable.

name: set_pointer_from_table_entry
description: Reads an index value and stores a pointer, computed from a four-byte table entry relative to the state block base, in a state-block field.

name: run_two_subroutines

name: restart_audio_channel_sample

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When a destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of a state block into it, then calls a routine through a function pointer.

name: build_buffer_from_list_maximum
description: Scans a linked list for its largest value, allocates a buffer sized from that value and fills it with a header word followed by an incrementing sequence. It then sets up a sixteen-longword block and calls routines, returning a failure code when no buffer can be set up.

name: copy_sixteen_longs_then_call
description: When a destination pointer is non-null, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of a state block into it, then calls a routine through a function pointer.

name: start_command_or_wait_workbench
description: Opens the DOS library and allocates a process record holding the argument count and argument list. It parses a command line with quoted arguments and star escapes for newline and escape characters, or otherwise waits for the Workbench startup message; it then calls a routine and releases the record.

name: release_task_state_and_return
description: Stores its argument in a slot of a task record, calls the cleanup routines that are present for that record, then returns the stored argument.

name: launch_tool_via_workbench
description: Opens the libraries it needs and allocates a 160-byte block for a tool launch. It processes a name string with XOR passes and calls library routines, and it reports a failed start with the error code.

name: compare_strings
description: Compares two zero-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one if the first sorts lower at the first difference, one if it sorts higher, and zero when they match.

name: build_node_list_from_chain
description: Walks a chain of entries, allocating a cleared eight-byte node for each, copying a looked-up value into it and linking the nodes together. It returns the head of the list, or the nodes built so far when a step fails.

name: pad_release_version_text
description: Compares a text buffer with a stored release string. When the buffer's character at position 20 is a 2 and the stored string matches to its end, it writes a dot and four spaces over five bytes at position 17.

name: write_release_padding
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into five bytes of a text buffer at a fixed offset.

name: match_prefix_against_global_string
description: Compares a text buffer with a global string character by character, stopping at the end of the global string or at the first mismatch. It returns no value.

name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing and returns; the code is a bare return with no work done.

name: call_with_stack_slot_argument
description: Calls another routine with its two parameters plus a pointer to a stack slot as a third argument.

name: format_text_and_output

name: dispatch_dos_packet_actions
description: Services a DOS packet loop by reading each action code and handling read, write, open and end requests. Each action sets the matching reply fields and calls library routines until the packet loop finishes.

name: validate_disk_block_bitmap
description: Walks a range of disk blocks, comparing bitmap bits with per-block flags and calling routines to process each mismatched block. It writes a two-digit status into a text field before the walk.

name: copy_memory_then_dispatch
description: Calls the exec library's CopyMem through a library vector, then transfers control through a jump table entry that the decompiler could not resolve.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The bytes decode as invalid instructions, so this is data rather than code. It contributes no behaviour.

name: allocate_serial_buffer_and_init
description: Optionally calls one library routine, then, when a size is given, allocates a buffer through the library and stores its address and size in the device record. It clears the pointer fields and sets two fields to half and a quarter of the size.

name: reply_request_when_unflagged
description: Stores a fixed byte at one offset of a request block, then when a status mask is clear replies to the request message through the exec library.

name: pause_serial_interrupts_around_call
description: Clears the serial transmit and receive buffer interrupt enable bits, calls a routine, then sets those bits again.

name: remove_request_from_queue
description: Clears a status byte on a request block, then unlinks the request from one of two queues depending on its type and state. It adjusts the queue count and replies to the request through the exec library when it is not marked as in use.

name: unlink_request_and_reply
description: Removes a request from the active queue, either as its head or from between its neighbours, and decrements the queue count. It clears the request's status and replies to it through the exec library when it is not marked as in use.

name: unlink_queued_request_and_reply
description: When a request is marked as queued, unlinks it from its neighbours, decrements the queue count, clears its status and replies to it through the exec library when it is not marked as in use.

name: finish_serial_request_queue_entry
description: Removes a request from its queue and, when it is the head of the second queue and of a particular type, clears the pending serial receive interrupt request. It then marks the request as finished and replies to it through the exec library.

name: unlink_queued_request_and_reply
description: When a request is marked as queued, unlinks it from its neighbours, decrements the queue count, clears its status and replies to it through the exec library when it is not marked as in use.

name: flag_or_release_serial_request
description: When a status word is non-zero, flags the device record as having a pending request and returns zero. Otherwise it releases the request's library resources, unlinks its entry and returns the value stored in the request.

name: release_serial_request_resources
description: Calls a series of library routines through the device's library base to release a request's resources, unlinks its entry from the list, and returns a value stored in the request.

name: queue_serial_request_or_reply
description: Queues a request onto the device's pending list when it has a length and the device is free, marking it as queued. Otherwise it replies to the request when it is not in use.

name: transfer_bytes_to_next_request
description: Takes the next queued request and copies buffered serial bytes into its data area while it has room. It stores a completion code chosen from the device status bits and replies to the request once it finishes.

name: copy_ring_buffer_into_request
description: Copies bytes from the serial ring buffer into the current read request, stopping when the request is full, the ring buffer runs dry, or a terminator byte is read.

name: fill_next_request_from_ring
description: Writes received bytes from the ring buffer into the next queued request, moving on to the following request when one completes, and replies to each finished request through the exec library.

name: drain_ring_buffer_into_requests
description: Runs the same request-filling loop as its neighbours, moving buffered bytes into queued read requests and returning the last byte handled.

name: clear_bit_then_drain_ring
description: Clears one bit in its argument, then fills queued read requests from the ring buffer in the same way as its neighbours, returning the final value.

name: stub_return_only
description: Does nothing and returns; the code is a bare return with no work done.

name: set_status_then_fill_requests
description: Stores a completion code in a request chosen from the status bits, then fills queued read requests from the ring buffer using the same loop as its neighbours.

name: set_completion_code_then_fill
description: Stores a completion code of 12 or 9 in the current request, depending on a status bit, then runs the same queued-request fill loop as its neighbours.

name: set_completion_code_then_fill
description: Stores a completion code of 12, 6, 9 or 15 in the current request from the status bits, then runs the same queued-request fill loop as its neighbours.

name: handle_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Services the serial receive interrupt: it acknowledges the receive request bit, reads the received byte and handles break conditions. It matches handshake characters, then stores the byte in the ring buffer or a waiting read request.

name: store_byte_in_ring_buffer
description: Compares a received byte with the device's handshake characters and sets or clears the stop and start flags accordingly. Otherwise it stores the byte in the ring buffer and calls a library routine when the buffer is nearly full.

name: store_byte_with_flow_control
description: When a status bit is set, checks a device flag and either marks the buffer as full or stores the received byte in the ring buffer. It calls a library routine when the buffer is nearly full.

name: store_byte_or_flag_full
description: When the received value's high status bit is clear, stores the byte in the ring buffer and calls a library routine when the buffer is nearly full. Otherwise it sets the buffer-full flag.

name: store_byte_on_status
description: Compares a status bit with a device flag. When they match it sets the buffer-full flag, and otherwise it stores the byte in the ring buffer.

name: flag_buffer_full_and_signal
description: Sets the buffer-full status bit, records the current ring buffer position when none is recorded, and calls a library routine to signal the change.

name: store_byte_in_ring_buffer
description: Stores the received byte in the ring buffer and calls a library routine when the buffer is nearly full. It records the current position first when none is recorded.

name: record_position_and_signal
description: Records the current ring buffer position when none is recorded, then calls a library routine to signal the change.

name: update_serial_control_lines
description: Stores the device's control value, clears a status flag, and updates the serial control outputs through the CIA port register, enabling or clearing one line according to the device flags.

name: set_serial_control_lines
description: Stores a second control value, sets a status flag, and drives the serial control outputs through the CIA port register, enabling the line when the device flags require it.

name: clear_serial_status_byte
description: Clears one status byte of the device record and returns.

name: start_serial_request_if_idle
description: When a status flag is clear, sets it, clears a pair of fields, stores a request code of 9 and calls a library routine. A non-zero status byte from that call sets the result code to 11.
